core_categories: E-Pharmacy; OTC Healthcare; Diagnostic Lab Tests; Teleconsultation; Medical Devices; Chronic Care Management
specialty_focus: PharmEasy is an Indian digital healthcare platform and super app that delivers prescription medicines, OTC products, and diagnostic lab tests to consumers' homes. It specializes in diagnostic lab tests with home sample pickup, teleconsultations, chronic care management, and a WomenCare segment. It operates as a marketplace connecting consumers with retail pharmacies and diagnostic partners, and also has B2B distribution arms.
